info.title: School Management API
info.description:
REST API for the School Management service.

**Conventions**

- Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. Every error body carries a stable `errorCode` and a `traceId`; branch on `errorCode`, never on the human-readable `detail`.
- Validation failures return **422** with a `errors` object keyed by property name. A **400** means the request itself was malformed (unparseable JSON, wrong query parameter type).
- Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 with an explicit offset. Convert to a local zone in the UI only.
- IDs are opaque strings. Do not parse them or assume a format.
- Collections are always paginated in the standard envelope. `pageSize` is capped at 100 and a larger value is rejected, not silently reduced.
- Enums cross the wire as strings. Tolerate members you do not recognise rather than failing to deserialise.
- Unknown fields in a request body are REJECTED with **400**, not ignored — a misspelled field is reported rather than silently dropped.
- An unknown path returns **401**, not 404. Endpoints are protected by default and the policy applies to unmatched routes too, so route existence cannot be probed without authenticating. A 401 on a URL you believe exists may simply be a typo.

**Authentication is not yet configured.** Endpoints are protected by default; while the identity provider decision is outstanding, protected endpoints return 401 for every caller. See `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md` in the repository.

get.description: Sets the `__Host-XSRF-TOKEN` cookie and returns the same value in the response body. Call on app load, including a reload while already signed in — the cookie is bound to the caller's current session when one is live, and to an anonymous subject otherwise, so this never invalidates an existing session's ability to mutate. Also call it once before sign-in: sign-in is itself CSRF-protected, so this is what bootstraps the pair. Echo the returned value verbatim in an `X-CSRF-Token` header on every subsequent mutating `/auth/*` request; axios does this automatically via its `xsrfCookieName`/`xsrfHeaderName` configuration.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Requires an `X-CSRF-Token` header matching the `__Host-XSRF-TOKEN` cookie from `GET /auth/csrf`. On success, sets the `__Host-Session` cookie and rotates the CSRF cookie to one bound to the new session. Rate-limited under the sensitive policy (spec 6.1.11). A wrong password, an unknown email, and a locked account given a wrong password all return the identical generic 401 body — `423` fires ONLY when the submitted password is correct and the account is currently locked, so only the real account holder ever learns that.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The value of the __Host-XSRF-TOKEN cookie, echoed verbatim (double-submit CSRF, approved contract delta §5). Obtain it from GET /auth/csrf or from a prior response's Set-Cookie.

post.description: Revokes the current session if one exists. Always `204`, including when called with no session or an already-dead one — a repeat sign-out is naturally idempotent. Still requires a valid CSRF token.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The value of the __Host-XSRF-TOKEN cookie, echoed verbatim (double-submit CSRF, approved contract delta §5). Obtain it from GET /auth/csrf or from a prior response's Set-Cookie.

get.summary: Report the caller's own account and session state
get.description: Replaces `GET /api/v1/reference/whoami` (removed). Always `200` once authenticated — including while `mustChangePassword` is true, which is how the frontend learns the flag on a hard reload rather than only right after sign-in.

post.summary: Proactively extend the session's idle window
post.description: Extends the idle timeout ahead of expiry; does not rotate the session token (spec 9.1 rotates only on privilege and password change). Call this BEFORE a session goes stale — all three 401 variants are terminal here too, so a reactive 401 from any endpoint should route straight to sign-in rather than calling this. Subject to the must-change-password gate: returns `403 auth.password_change_required` while that flag is set, unlike `me`.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The value of the __Host-XSRF-TOKEN cookie, echoed verbatim (double-submit CSRF, approved contract delta §5). Obtain it from GET /auth/csrf or from a prior response's Set-Cookie.

post.description: Requires the current password (a re-authentication check for a sensitive action, spec 9.1). Rotates the session token and revokes every OTHER active session for the account (spec 6.1.11) — this session survives. Rejects a new password matching any of the last five hashes. Rate-limited under the sensitive policy: `currentPassword` is an online guessing surface too.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The value of the __Host-XSRF-TOKEN cookie, echoed verbatim (double-submit CSRF, approved contract delta §5). Obtain it from GET /auth/csrf or from a prior response's Set-Cookie.

get.summary: Check that the API is reachable
get.description: Echoes the supplied name with the server's UTC time and the API version. Useful as a smoke test of routing, serialisation and the request pipeline. Requires no authentication and touches no database.

Returns one page of records in the standard pagination envelope. `page` is 1-based and defaults to 1; `pageSize` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. A `pageSize` above the cap is REJECTED with 422 rather than silently reduced, so a client paging through results cannot skip rows while believing it read everything.

post.description: Creates a record and returns 201 with a `Location` header. The label must be unique among live (not soft-deleted) records; a duplicate returns 409. Runs inside a transaction that is rolled back if the command fails.

get.summary: Read an arm-scoped resource, gated by the privilege substrate
get.description: Requires `arm.view`, scoped to the arm named in the path. Anonymous callers get 401; an authenticated caller who lacks the privilege, or who holds it only over a different arm, gets 403 with a generic body naming neither the privilege nor whether the arm exists.
Everything in one payload for the settings area (spec 6.2.12). Returns only the `identity` group as of TASK-0005a; later cards extend this same envelope additively with sibling groups.

patch.description: School name, short name, address, phone, email, motto, head teacher name (spec 6.2.3). `timezone` and `abbreviation` are not editable here — timezone is fixed, and the abbreviation has its own endpoint and its own optimistic-concurrency pointer. `expectedVersion` must match the identity group's current `versionNumber` (from `GET /settings`) or the save is rejected `409` before anything is written, and BOTH the winning and the losing attempt are recorded on the audit trail (spec 6.2.11).

parameters.description: The value of the __Host-XSRF-TOKEN cookie, echoed verbatim (double-submit CSRF, approved contract delta §5). Obtain it from GET /auth/csrf or from a prior response's Set-Cookie.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (UUID v4 recommended), 1-255 visible ASCII characters, no whitespace. Optional. A retry with the same key returns the stored response unchanged and sets the `Idempotency-Replay` response header, rather than repeating the request's effect.

Idempotency-Replay.description: Present and set to "true" only when this response is a replay of a prior request that used the same Idempotency-Key, rather than a fresh execution.

get.description: Cursor-paginated per spec 9.5 — never offset. `cursor` is the opaque `nextCursor` from a previous page; omit it for the first page. `pageSize` defaults to 25 and is capped at 100.

get.summary: Read one configuration version in full, including its snapshot
get.description: Includes the full `snapshot` — the whole serialised configuration as of this save (spec 6.2.9), not only the group that changed.

accountId.description: Opaque identifier (root CLAUDE.md §8 — never parsed by the client).

isSuperAdmin.description: Whether the flag-bypass privilege path applies (TASK-0003 §1).

mustChangePassword.description: Whether the forced-change gate currently applies to this account.

effectivePrivileges.description:
The caller's resolved effective privilege set. For this card, populated only via the
bool AuthSessionResponse.IsSuperAdmin flag path — see `SuperAdminFlagEffectivePrivilegeProvider`.

sessionExpiresAt.description: The sooner of the session's idle and absolute deadlines, recomputed on every response.

sessionAbsoluteExpiresAt.description: The session's fixed absolute deadline (spec 6.1.11's 8-hour cap), set once at sign-in.

AuthSessionResponse.description:
Shared response shape returned by `sign-in`, `me`, `refresh` and `password`
(approved contract delta §0), so the frontend never needs a second round trip to learn its own
state after any of the four.

currentPassword.description:
Must match the account's current password (re-authentication for a
            sensitive action).

newPassword.description:
Must satisfy spec 6.1.11's composition rule and must not match any of the
            last int AuthPolicy.PasswordHistoryLimit hashes (checked in the handler, which needs the
            password hasher — not expressible as a synchronous FluentValidation rule).

ChangePasswordCommand.description:
Self-service password change (spec 6.1.11, spec 6.1.14). Approved contract delta:
`POST /api/v1/auth/password`. The account comes from the caller's own session — this is never
how another account's password is changed (that is `admin.password.reset`, TASK-0019).

changedGroup.description: Which settings group this save changed.

actorAdminId.description: The acting administrator's id, or `null` for a system action.

reason.description:
The reason given for this save, or `null` when the changed group's rule does not
require one (6.2.10) — always `null` for an `Identity` row.

snapshot.description:
The whole serialised configuration as of this save (6.2.9) — every group's values at that moment,
not only the one that changed.

id.description: Opaque id. Pass to `GET /api/v1/config-versions/{id}` for the full detail.

changedGroup.description: Which settings group this save changed.

actorAdminId.description: The acting administrator's id, or `null` for a system action.

ConfigVersionSummaryDto.description:
One row of `GET /api/v1/config-versions`'s cursor-paged list — everything except the
snapshot itself, which only the detail endpoint returns.

label.description: A short label for the record. Required, unique among live records.

note.example: Carried over from the previous academic year.

example.label: Term 1 timetable draft

id.description:
The new record's opaque identifier. Returned in the body as well as in the `Location`
header, so a client need not parse the URL to learn it.

csrfToken.description:
Opaque token — also set as the `__Host-XSRF-TOKEN` cookie. Echo verbatim in an `X-CSRF-Token`
header on every mutating `/auth/*` request.

items.description: The page of items, newest first. Empty (never null) when there is nothing more to return.

nextCursor.description: `null` when this is the last page.

CursorPageOfConfigVersionSummaryDto.description:
The cursor-pagination response envelope (spec 9.5). string? CursorPage<TItem>.NextCursor is opaque to the
client — it must be echoed back verbatim as the next request's cursor, and never parsed or
constructed by hand.

scope.description: Whether this grant applies school-wide or over a named list of arms.

armIds.description: The arms this grant covers. Empty when Scope is school-wide.

EffectivePrivilegeDto.description:
One entry of IReadOnlyList<EffectivePrivilegeDto> AuthSessionResponse.EffectivePrivileges, mirroring PrivilegeGrant
            minus its session id — that field is server-internal and never crosses the wire.

detail.example: A record with that label already exists.

errorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Clients branch on this, never on `detail`. Absent when this response was produced directly by the framework rather than by this API's own result mapping.

traceId.description: Correlation id for this specific response occurrence. Present on every error response; quote it when reporting a problem.

HttpValidationProblemDetails.description: An RFC 9457 problem response for a validation failure, returned with status 422. Extends the standard problem shape with `errors`: an object keyed by request property name, whose values are the messages for that property, suitable for attaching to form fields. A 400 (rather than 422) means the request itself could not be parsed.

example.title: Validation failed
example.detail: One or more validation errors occurred.

JsonElement.description: The whole serialised configuration as of this version (spec 6.2.9) — free-form JSON, because every settings card adds its own section to the same snapshot shape. Read it as an opaque object; do not assume today's set of keys is complete.

items.description: The page of items. Empty (never null) when the page is past the end.

example.label: Term 1 timetable draft
example.note: Carried over from the previous academic year.

page.description: The 1-based page number that produced this response.

pageSize.description: The page size that produced this response, after clamping.

totalCount.description:
Total matching rows across all pages. long because a table can exceed
int rows, and discovering that in production is not the moment to find out.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages available at this page size. Zero when there are no rows.

hasNextPage.description: Whether a page after this one exists.

hasPreviousPage.description: Whether a page before this one exists.

PagedResultOfSampleRecordDto.description:
The one pagination response envelope for the whole API. Consistency here is what lets the
frontend write a single generic paging hook instead of one per endpoint.

items.label: Term 1 timetable draft
items.note: Carried over from the previous academic year.

message.description: A greeting echoing the supplied name.

serverTimeUtc.description:
Server time when the request was handled. Always UTC with an explicit offset (ISO-8601), per the
repo-wide rule that timestamps cross the wire as DateTimeOffset and are converted
to a local zone only in the UI.

apiVersion.description:
The API version that served the request, matching the URL segment — useful when a client is
unsure which version a proxy routed it to.

PingResponse.description:
Response to a PingQuery. Confirms the service is reachable and that its clock,
serialisation, and API version are what the caller expects.

detail.example: A record with that label already exists.

errorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Clients branch on this, never on `detail`. Absent when this response was produced directly by the framework (for example a model-binding failure or an authentication challenge) rather than by this API's own result mapping.

traceId.description: Correlation id for this specific response occurrence. Present on every error response; quote it when reporting a problem.

ProblemDetails.description: An RFC 9457 problem response. Returned for every error. Branch on the `errorCode` extension member — it is stable — and never on `detail`, which is human-readable prose that may be reworded. `traceId` identifies this specific occurrence in the server logs; quote it when reporting a problem. `type` is a stable URN of the form `urn:schoolmanagement:error:<code>`.

example.title: Conflict with current state
example.detail: A record with that label already exists.

id.description:
Opaque identifier. A STRING on the wire even though it is a GUID in the database, per the
repo-wide rule that IDs are opaque to clients — that way the storage key type can change without
breaking them.

note.description: The optional note, or `null` if none was supplied.
note.example: Carried over from the previous academic year.

createdAtUtc.description: When the record was created. UTC, ISO-8601 with offset.

modifiedAtUtc.description: When the record was last modified, or `null` if never.

SampleRecordDto.description: REFERENCE SLICE — read model for a sample record.

example.label: Term 1 timetable draft
example.note: Carried over from the previous academic year.

ScopeType.description:
How a role assignment's grant is bounded. Spec 4.2: "Scope is one of two things: school-wide,
or a list of specific arms in a specific session."

armId.description: The arm named in the request path — the resolved scope target.

SecureArmResponse.description: The arm-scoped resource `GetSecureArm` returns once the privilege check passes.

SettingsDto.description:
The response body of `GET /api/v1/settings`. Only SettingsIdentityGroupDto SettingsDto.Identity exists as of
TASK-0005a; TASK-0005b and TASK-0005c extend this same envelope additively with sibling groups
(logo/signature are read through SettingsIdentityGroupDto SettingsDto.Identity's own follow-up serving endpoints rather
than a new top-level field, and registration-number/abbreviation get their own group here).

schoolName.description: Full school name. Appears in full on the result sheet header.

shortName.description: Used where the full name will not fit, for example the pin slip.

motto.description: `null` when unset. Printed under the school name if present.

headTeacherName.description: Printed above the head teacher's signature block.

timezone.description: Always `Africa/Lagos`. Fixed; a `PATCH` cannot change it.

versionNumber.description:
The identity group's current optimistic-concurrency pointer. Echo this back as
`expectedVersion` on the next `PATCH`.

SettingsIdentityGroupDto.description:
The school identity group, both inside SettingsDto and as
`PATCH /api/v1/settings/identity`'s own success body (spec 6.2.3).

email.description:
The account's login identifier. SignInCommandValidator DOES
            check this is a well-formed email address — that check runs (and can reject) before the Argon2id
            verify, but it does not reopen spec 6.1.11's timing concern: format validation happens identically
            whether or not any account with that shape of address exists, so it cannot distinguish "known
            email" from "unknown email" the way the Argon2id verify's presence/absence would.

password.description:
The submitted plaintext password. Never logged (redacted by field name — see
            `RedactSensitivePropertiesEnricher` — and never included in the request-logging behaviour's
            output in the first place, since that behaviour logs only the request TYPE name).

SignInCommand.description:
Signs an administrator in (spec 6.1.11, spec 9.1). Approved contract delta:
`POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in`.

shortName.description: Used where the full name will not fit.

motto.description: `null` to leave the school with no motto.

headTeacherName.description: Printed above the head teacher's signature block.

expectedVersion.description:
The identity group's current `versionNumber`, as last read from `GET /settings`. A
stale value is rejected `409 settings.identity.stale_version` before anything is written.

UpdateSchoolIdentityCommand.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/settings/identity` (spec 6.2.3). string SchoolProfile.Abbreviation and
        string SchoolProfile.Timezone are deliberately absent from this body — the abbreviation is
        TASK-0005c's own endpoint, and the timezone is fixed and not editable in this version.

CookieSession.description: Opaque session token set by POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in. HttpOnly — the browser attaches it automatically; it is never readable or settable from JavaScript.
